annotations.title: Add a book to my library

description: Log reading on the signed-in reader's Siftivo shelves: add a book to want to read (NOT_STARTED), mark it READING, FINISHED or DNF, rate it, or record progress. Suits "add X to my list", "I just finished X, four stars" and "I'm halfway through X". "Finished it, four and a half stars" is one call with readingStatus FINISHED and rating 4.5. The workId comes from search_books. Each field given replaces what the reader had there before, so send a rating or a note only when they asked for that one to change. Omitting readingStatus leaves the book on the shelf it is already on. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

notes.description: The reader's own note on the book, private to them

readingStatus.description: The shelf to put the book on. Omit to leave it where it is, or NOT_STARTED for a book the reader has not opened yet.
